name: matchmaker
description: AceUp is an app to organize sports matches by managing player availability, sending invites, and confirming participation through unique links. WhatsApp is used only as a delivery channel for notifications and links.

scripts.build:deploy: npm install && npm run prisma:generate && npm run build
scripts.start:prod: node scripts/ensure-database-url.js npx prisma@6.19.2 migrate deploy && cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.production node dist/server.js
scripts.migrate:deploy: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.local node scripts/ensure-database-url.js npx prisma@6.19.2 migrate deploy
scripts.migrate:deploy:local: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.local node scripts/ensure-database-url.js npx prisma@6.19.2 migrate deploy
scripts.migrate:deploy:prod: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.production node scripts/ensure-database-url.js npx prisma@6.19.2 migrate deploy
scripts.migrate:resolve: node scripts/ensure-database-url.js npx prisma@6.19.2 migrate resolve
scripts.migrate:dev: node scripts/ensure-database-url.js npx prisma@6.19.2 migrate dev
scripts.seed: cross-env ENV_FILE=.env.local ENVIRONMENT=DEVELOPMENT npx tsx prisma/seeders/seed.ts
